answer: Fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. A new agent locks 25 tokens in escrow and works a rhythm, like a tide, for 10 epochs. That rhythm is a fingerprint as distinctive as saffron: each agent's kernel of habits — timing, task mix, speed — is unique and hard to fake. A match unlocks deposit plus earnings; a mismatch burns it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 tokens plus 10 epochs of work each. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
